title: Recover a dual-read register file and collision behavior

expected_output.description: Synthesizable Verilog module implementing a 4-entry by 8-bit register file with one synchronous write port and two independent, purely combinational read ports, matching the pinned port list and timing contract in README.md.

metrics.name: cycle_accurate_match_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of simulated clock cycles across all randomized test sequences (writes, reads, collisions, resets) in which rdata0 and rdata1 from the submission exactly match the independently generated reference design.

metrics.name: word_recovery_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the four architecturally distinct register entries (0-3) for which the submission demonstrably recovers correct read/write mapping under targeted single-address write-then-read test vectors.

metrics.name: structural_match_accuracy
metrics.description: Static structural check (fail-on-presence only) confirming the submission uses explicit clocked storage (no latches/no combinational feedback loops) and purely combinational read multiplexing, used only to flag disallowed constructs, never to grant a PASS.

metrics.name: functional_equivalence
metrics.description: Boolean pass/fail per test scenario (basic read/write, collision, reset-then-read, dual-port independence) indicating whether the submission's simulated I/O behavior is functionally equivalent to the reference across the full randomized regression.

baselines: naive stub submission tying rdata0/rdata1 to zero (must fail)
